function @nav($pitch:number, $roll:number, $vertV:number)
	var $w = $wsoNav.width
	var $h = $wsoNav.height
	
	$pitch = 2*$pitch * 90
	$roll = $roll * 180
	
	$wsoNav.blank()
	screen_copy($navball, $wsoNav, 0, 180+$pitch, 50, 15, 80, 80, -1, $roll)
	screen_copy($navballFrame, $wsoNav, 0, 0, 30, -5, 120, 120)
	
	;vertical velocity display
	var $vertVShift = clamp(($vertV),-90,90)
	screen_copy($vertVShape, $wsoNav,0, 0, 105, 25,60,60)
	screen_copy($vertVDial, $wsoNav,0, 0, 105, 25,120,60,-1,$vertVShift)

function @rot($rol:number,$pit:number,$yaw:number, $xl:number,$yl:number,$zl:number)
	var $cr = cos($rol);
	var $sr = sin($rol);
	var $cp = cos($pit);
	var $sp = sin($pit);
	var $cy = cos($yaw);
	var $sy = sin($yaw);
	
	$global.x = $zl*($cy*$sp*$cr+$sy*$sr)+$yl*($cy*$sp*$sr-$sy*$cr)+$xl*($cy*$cp)
	$global.y = $zl*($sy*$sp*$cr-$cy*$sr)+$yl*($sy*$sp*$sr+$cy*$cr)+$xl*($sy*$cp)
	$global.z = $zl*($cp*$cr)+$yl*($sr*$cp)-$xl*($sp)
	

function @radar($x:number,$y:number,$z:number, $d:number, $freq:text)
	var $dim = $radar.width/2
	var $dim2 = 70
	
	var $alt = input_number("nav",2)
	var $roll = -input_number("nav",5)*3.14159
	var $pitch = -(input_number("nav",4))*3.14159/2
	var $yaw = input_number("nav",6)
	
	if $yaw > 180
		$yaw = ($yaw - 360)/180*3.14159
	else 
		$yaw = $yaw/180*3.14159
	
	;print($roll, $pitch, $yaw)
	
	@rot($roll, $pitch, $yaw, -$z,$y, -$x)
	
	$dist = sqrt($global.x^2+$global.y^2)
	
	var $b = $d
	var $c = $rEarth + $alt
	var $aAngle = 0
	var $bAngle = 0
	
	$aAngle = acos($global.z)
		
	var$a = sqrt($b^2+$c^2-2*$b*$c*cos($aAngle))
	$distVert = ($a - $rEarth)/1000
	;;print($alt)
	
	if $a != 0
		$bAngle = asin(sin($aAngle)*$b/$a)
	else
		$bAngle = asin(sin($aAngle)*$b/0.00001)
	
	$dist = $c*$bAngle
	
	if $global.x == 0
		$dir = atan($global.y,0.0000001)
	else
		$dir =  atan($global.y,-$global.x)
	
	var $angle = $yaw + $dir-3.14159
	
	$dist = ($dist/1000)
	
	var $shiftx = clamp($dist/$range,0,1)*$dim2*sin($angle)
	var $shifty = -clamp($dist/$range,0,1)*$dim2*cos($angle)
	
	$radarScr1.draw_circle($dim-$shiftx, $dim+$shifty, 3, green, green)
	;$radarScr1.draw_line($dim-$shiftx, $dim+$shifty, $dim, $dim, color(255,255,255*($freq != $target)))

function @fov_radar($freq:text)
	var $w = $fovRadar.width
	var $h = $fovRadar.height
	var $scale = ($h-30)/$range
	var $yaw = input_number("nav",6)
	var $alt = input_number("nav",2)/1000
	
	if $yaw > 180
		$yaw = ($yaw - 360)/180*3.14159
	else 
		$yaw = $yaw/180*3.14159
	
	var $angle = $yaw + $dir -3.14159
	
	var $shiftx = clamp($dist,0,$range)*$scale*sin($angle)
	var $shifty = clamp($dist,0,$range)*$scale*cos($angle)
	
	if $distVert-$alt > 0
		$fovScr1.write($w/2-30-$shiftx, $h-12-$shifty, green, text("+{0.0} ", $distVert-$alt) & $freq)
	else
		$fovScr1.write($w/2-30-$shiftx, $h-12-$shifty, green, text("{0.0} ", $distVert-$alt) & $freq)
	
	$fovScr1.draw_circle($w/2-$shiftx, $h-20-$shifty, 4, green, green)

update
	var $hdg = input_number("nav",6)
	var $forV = input_number("nav",0)
	var $vertV = input_number("nav",1)
	var $alt = input_number("nav",2)
	var $roll = input_number("nav",5)
	var $pitch = input_number("nav",4)
	var $yaw = $hdg
	
	if $yaw > 180
		$yaw = ($yaw - 360)/180*pi
	else 
		$yaw = $yaw/180*pi
	
	
	var $speed = input_number("nav", 0)
	var $vertG = -input_number("phys", 9)
	var $vx = input_number("linv",0)
	var $vy = input_number("linv",1)
	var $vz = input_number("linv",2)
	var $vt = sqrt($vx^2+$vy^2+$vz^2)
	
	if $vz == 0
		$vz = 0.1
	
	var $aoa = -sign($vy)*acos($vz/sqrt($vy^2+$vz^2))
	var $slip = -sign($vx)*acos($vz/sqrt($vx^2+$vz^2))
	
	
	@nav($pitch, $roll, $vertV)
	;@ordinanceScr()
	
	if $radarSW
		if $scanSW == 1 && $targetList.size > 0
			$radar.blank()
			if $tickNum == 0
				output_text("radarbeac",2, $targetList.$scan)
				$tickNum++
			elseif $tickNum == 2
				if $scan == 0
					$targetListActive.clear()
					$targetListActive.fill($targetList.size,0)
				
				$targetListActive.$scan = input_number("radarbeac",5)
					
				$scan++
				
				if $scan > $targetList.size-1 
					$scanSW = 0
					$scan = 0
					if $target == "" && $targetList.size > 0
						$target = $targetList.0
				$tickNum = 0
			else
				$tickNum++
		else
			
					
			if $targetListActive.sum > 0;radar screen
			
				if $tickNum == 0
					output_text("beac1",2, $targetList.$scan)
					$tickNum++
				elseif $tickNum == 2
					$tickNum = 0
					$dist = input_number("radarbeac",1)
					;print($target,$bogeys.$scan)
					if $targetListActive.$scan
						@radar(input_number("radarbeac",3),input_number("radarbeac",2),input_number("radarbeac",4),input_number("radarbeac",1),$targetList.$scan)
						@fov_radar($targetList.$scan)
					
						if $targetList.$scan == $target 
							$targetDist = $dist
							$targetFound = input_number("radarbeac",5)
					$scan++
					if $scan > $targetList.size -1
						$scan = 0
						$radar.blank()
						$fovRadar.blank()
						;@radarShapes()
						$radarScr1.blank(0)
						if $targetFound 
							if $targetDist < 10
								$radar.write(8,$radar.height -17,green,text("{0.0}km", $targetDist))
							else
								$radar.write(8,$radar.height -17,green,text("{0}km", $targetDist))
							$radar.write($radar.width-20,$radar.height -17,green,text("{0}km", $alt-$distVert))
						else
							$radar.write(8,147,green,"???")
						$targetFound = 0
						
				
					$radar.text_size(1)
					
					$radar.write(6,165,green,"Target")
					$radar.write(49,165,green,$target)
				
				else
					$tickNum++
						
				
			else
				$scanSW = 1			
	else
		$radar.blank()

function @damp($input:number, $const1:number, $const2:number) : number
	return $input  * $const1 * (input_number("dens", 0)+0.8)  / (1 + (input_number("nav", 0) / ($const2*100))^2)
	
	
function @squarein($input:number) : number
	return sign($input) * $input * $input
	
function @pitchLadder($pitch:number, $roll:number, $aoa:number, $slip:number)
	$roll  = -input_number("nav",5)*180
	$pitch = $pitch*544
	
	$plad2.blank(0);
	screen_copy($plad1, $plad2, 0, 403+$pitch, 0, 0, $plad1.width, $plad1.height)
	screen_copy($plad2, $hgs, 0, 0, 0, 0, $plad2.width, $plad2.height, -1, -$roll)
	;print($aoa,$slip)
	$aoa = clamp(sin($aoa) * 50,-20,20)
	$slip = clamp($slip * 60,-20,20)
	screen_copy($reticle, $hgs, 0, 0, $slip, $aoa, 150, 174)
	

function @fuelScr()	
	var $vol1 = input_number("vol1",0)
	var $vol2 = input_number("vol2",0)
	var $vol3 = input_number("vol3",0)
	var $com = input_number("phys",7)
	
	var $vol1max = input_number("vol1",1)
	var $vol2max = input_number("vol2",1)
	var $vol3max = input_number("vol3",1)
	
	var $vol1Pressure = 8.31/1000 * input_number("vol1dens",0) * input_number("vol1temp",0)
	var $vol2Pressure = 8.31/1000 * input_number("vol2dens",0) * input_number("vol2temp",0)
	var $vol3Pressure = 8.31/1000 * input_number("vol3dens",0) * input_number("vol3temp",0)
	$fuelScr.blank()
	
	
	screen_copy($rect, $fuelScr, 0, 0, 85, 5+(20*(1-$vol1)), 20, 20-(20*(1-$vol1)))
	screen_copy($rect, $fuelScr, 0, 0, 85, 30+(55*(1-$vol2)), 20, 55-(55*(1-$vol2)))
	screen_copy($rect, $fuelScr, 0, 0, 85, 90+(55*(1-$vol3)), 20, 55-(55*(1-$vol3)))
	screen_copy($fuelShape, $fuelScr, 0, 0, 0, 0, 150, 150)
	
	$fuelScr.text_size(1)
	;individual tanks
	$fuelScr.write(106,5, color(255*($vol1 < 0.2),255*($vol1 > 0.05),0), text("{0.0}%", $vol1*100))
	$fuelScr.write(106,45, color(255*($vol2 < 0.2),255*($vol2 > 0.05),0), text("{0.0}%", $vol2*100))
	$fuelScr.write(106,105, color(255*($vol3 < 0.2),255*($vol3 > 0.05),0), text("{0.0}%", $vol3*100))
	;tank pressures
	$fuelScr.write(106,15, color(255,255*($vol1Pressure > 10),255*($vol1Pressure > 100)), text("{0.00}kPa", $vol1Pressure/1000))
	$fuelScr.write(106,55, color(255,255*($vol2Pressure > 10),255*($vol2Pressure > 100)), text("{0.00}kPa", $vol2Pressure/1000))
	$fuelScr.write(106,115, color(255,255*($vol3Pressure > 10),255*($vol3Pressure > 100)), text("{0.00}kPa", $vol3Pressure/1000))
	;com
	$fuelScr.write(5,82, white, text("{0.00}m",$com-0.25))
	$fuelScr.draw_circle(55,85 - (40*clamp($com-0.25,-1,1)), 5, yellow,yellow)
	
	;total 
	var $volTotalMax = $vol1max + $vol2max + $vol3max
	if $volTotalMax == 0
		$volTotalMax = 50
	var $volTotal = ($vol1*$vol1max + $vol2*$vol2max + $vol3*$vol3max) / $volTotalMax
	$fuelScr.text_size(2)
	$fuelScr.write(5,10, color(255*($volTotal < 0.2),255*($volTotal > 0.05),0), text("{0.0}%", $volTotal*100))
	
	

function @hdgSlider($hdg:number)
	
	var $shift = $hdg*3
	
	if $hdg<80 
		screen_copy($hdg1Virt, $hgs, -27+$shift, 0, 40, 0, 70, $hgs.height)
		screen_copy($hdg2Virt, $hgs, 483+$shift, 0, 40, 0, 70, $hgs.height)
	elseif $hdg<170
		screen_copy($hdg1Virt, $hgs, -27+$shift, 0, 40, 0, 70, $hgs.height)
	elseif $hdg<200
		screen_copy($hdg1Virt, $hgs, -27+$shift, 0, 40, 0, 70, $hgs.height)
		screen_copy($hdg2Virt, $hgs, -57+$shift-540, 0, 40, 0, 70, $hgs.height)
	elseif $hdg<340
		screen_copy($hdg2Virt, $hgs, -57+$shift-540, 0, 40, 0, 70, $hgs.height)
	else
		screen_copy($hdg2Virt, $hgs, -57+$shift-540, 0, 40, 0, 70, $hgs.height)
		screen_copy($hdg1Virt, $hgs, -27+$shift-1080, 0, 40, 0, 70, $hgs.height)	

function @missileFire()
	if $fire
		;print(input_number("pilot",17), input_number("m1 data",0), input_number("m2 data",0))
		if input_number("m3",0)
			output_number("m3",0,0)
		elseif input_number("m4",0)
			output_number("m4",0,0)
		elseif input_number("m5",0)
			output_number("m5",0,0)
		elseif input_number("m6",0)
			output_number("m6",0,0)
		elseif input_number("wtm1",0)
			output_number("wtm1",0,0)
		elseif input_number("wtm2",0)
			output_number("wtm2",0,0)
	
		
	
function @p($set:number, $in:number, $k:number):number
	var $output = ($set-$in) * $k
	return $output
	
update
	var $hdg = input_number("nav",6)
	var $forV = input_number("nav",0)
	var $vertV = input_number("nav",1)
	var $alt = input_number("nav",2)
	var $roll = input_number("nav",5)
	var $pitch = input_number("nav",4)
	var $yaw = $hdg
	
	if $yaw > 180
		$yaw = ($yaw - 360)/180*pi
	else 
		$yaw = $yaw/180*pi
		
		
	var $vector = ".roll{}.pitch{}.yaw{}"
	$vector.roll = $roll
	$vector.pitch = $pitch
	$vector.yaw = $yaw
	output_text("nose cone",0,$vector)
	;@rot($roll, -$pitch, $yaw, -$z,$y, -$x)
	
	var $speed = input_number("nav", 0)
	var $vertG = -input_number("phys", 9)
	var $vx = input_number("linv",0)
	var $vy = input_number("linv",1)
	var $vz = input_number("linv",2)
	var $angvx = input_number("angv",0)
	var $angvy = input_number("angv",1)
	var $angvz = input_number("angv",2)
	var $vt = sqrt($vx^2+$vy^2+$vz^2)
	
	if $vz == 0
		$vz = 0.1
	
	var $aoa = -sign($vy)*acos($vz/sqrt($vy^2+$vz^2))
	var $slip = -sign($vx)*acos($vz/sqrt($vx^2+$vz^2))
	
	if $forV < 1
		$slip = 0
		$aoa = 0
	@missileFire()
	@fuelScr()	
	
	$hgs.blank(color(0,0,0,50))
	$hgs.text_align(top)
	;$hgs.write(0, 15, green, round($hdg):text)
	$hgs.text_align(top_left)
	$hgs.write(4, 100, green, text("  {0.0}", $aoa*180/pi))
	
	;mach
	var $temp = input_number("temp",0)
	var $atmoComp = input_text("dens",1)
	var $avgAdbInd = 1.4 * $atmoComp.O2 + 1.29 * $atmoComp.H2O + 1.31 * $atmoComp.CH4 + 1.29 * $atmoComp.CO2 + 1.4 * $atmoComp.N
	var $avgMM = 32 * $atmoComp.O2 + 18.02 * $atmoComp.H2O + 16.04 * $atmoComp.CH4 + 44.01 * $atmoComp.CO2 + 14.01 * $atmoComp.N
	$avgMM /= 1000 ; to kg
	if $avgMM == 0
		$avgMM = 0.014
	var $mach = sqrt($avgAdbInd * 8.31 * $temp / $avgMM)
	if $mach == 0
		$mach = 343
	;print(text("Mach: {0} m/s",$mach))
	
	$hgs.write(4, 110, green, text("M {0.0}", $forV / $mach))
	$hgs.write(4, 120, green, text("G {0.0}", $vertG))
	if $vertG > $maxG
		$maxG = $vertG
	$hgs.write(17, 130, green, text("{0.0}",$maxG))
	$hgs.text_align(right)
	$hgs.write(-6, -26, green, text("{0}",$alt*3.28084))
	if $vertV > 0
		$hgs.write(-6, -38, green, text("+{0}",$vertV*3.28084))
	else
		$hgs.write(-6, -38, green, text("{0}",$vertV*3.28084))
	$hgs.text_align(left)
	$hgs.write(10, -26, green, text("{0}",$forV*1.94384))
	screen_copy($hgsVirt, $hgs, 0, 0, 0, 0, $hgs.width, $hgs.height)
	
	@hdgSlider($hdg)
	@pitchLadder($pitch, $roll, $aoa, $slip)
	
	$pitchCtrl = 0
	$rollCtrl = 0
	var $rollSet = 0
	$yawCtrl = 0
	$spdCtrl = 0
	
	
	;set numpad---------------------------------------------------------
	if input_number("dash flight",19) 
		$numpadSetting = 1
		output_number("dash flight",19,1)
		output_number("dash flight",20,0)
		output_number("dash flight",21,0)
	
	if input_number("dash flight",20) 
		$numpadSetting = 2
		output_number("dash flight",19,0)
		output_number("dash flight",20,1)
		output_number("dash flight",21,0)
	
	if input_number("dash flight",21) 
		$numpadSetting = 3
		output_number("dash flight",19,0)
		output_number("dash flight",20,0)
		output_number("dash flight",21,1)

		
		
	;numpad--------------------------------------------------------------
	if input_number("numpad",1) && $numpadSetting == 1
		$spdSet = input_number("numpad",0)
	if input_number("numpad",1) && $numpadSetting == 2
		$altSet = input_number("numpad",0)
	if input_number("numpad",1) && $numpadSetting == 3
		$hdgSet = input_number("numpad",0)
	
	;speed set--------------------------------------------------------------
	if input_number("dash flight", 4) 
		if $spdSW == 1
			$spdSW = 0
		else
			$spdSW = 1
	if $spdSW
		$spdCtrl += @p($spdSet, $forV/0.51444, 0.09)
		output_number("dash flight", 4,color(0,255,0))
	else
		output_number("dash flight", 4,color(255,0,0))
	output_text("dash flight",11,text("{0}",$spdSet))
		
	
	;altitude set--------------------------------------------------------------
	if input_number("dash flight", 5) 
		if $altSW == 1
			$altSW = 0
		else
			$altSW = 1
	if $altSW 
		if $forV > 60 
			$pitchCtrl += @p(0, $angvx, -5)
			$pitchCtrl += @p(clamp(@p(0, (3.28084*$alt - $altSet-100), 0.04), -200, 200), $vertV/0.51444, 0.008)
			$rollCtrl += @p(0, $roll, -3)
		output_number("dash flight", 5,color(0,255,0))
	else
		output_number("dash flight", 5,color(255,0,0))
	output_text("dash flight",14,text("{0}",$altSet))
	
	
	;heading set--------------------------------------------------------------
	var $dir = ($hdg - $hdgSet)
	if $dir > 180
		$dir = ($dir-360)
	elseif $dir < -180
		$dir = (360+$dir)
	$dir = $dir/180
	print($hdg, $dir)
	
	if input_number("dash flight", 6) 
		if $hdgSW == 1
			$hdgSW = 0
		else
			$hdgSW = 1
	if $hdgSW 
		if $forV > 60 
			$yawCtrl += clamp(@p(0, $dir, 0.2), -1, 1)
			$yawCtrl += @p(0, $angvy, -0.1)
			$rollSet = clamp(@p(0, $dir, 1), -0.23, 0.23)
			;$rollCtrl += @p($rollSet, $roll, -2)
		output_number("dash flight", 6,color(0,255,0))
	else
		output_number("dash flight", 6,color(255,0,0))
	output_text("dash flight",15,text("{0}",$hdgSet))
		
		
	;fly by wire------------------------------------------------------------
	if input_number("dash flight",9)
		if $forV > 60 
			$rollCtrl += @p(0, $angvz, 2)
			$yawCtrl += @p(0, $angvy, -0.1)
			$yawCtrl += @p(0, $slip, -0.3)
		output_number("dash flight",10,1)
	else
		output_number("dash flight",10,0)
	;print($wsoNav.width, $wsoNav.height)
	
	;leveler-----------------------------------------------------------------
	if input_number("dash flight",8) && !input_number("pilot",8) && !$altSW
		;print($aoa) 
		$pitchCtrl += @p(0, $angvx, -1)
		$pitchCtrl += @p(3, $vertV * 1.94384, 0.002)
		$rollCtrl += @p(0, $roll, -2)
		output_number("dash flight",7,1)
	else
		output_number("dash flight",7,0)
